ruleDefinitions.name: File And SubFolder Enumeration Via Dir Command
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the "dir" command part of Widows CMD with the "/S" command line flag in order to enumerate files in a specified directory and all subdirectories.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*dir*\\-s.*"))
